name: Web server
description: A public VM that serves your site on port 80, behind a firewall.

fields.startup_script:
#!/bin/sh # Serve a page on port 80 with what the image has: python3 (Amazon Linux, # Ubuntu), else busybox httpd, else a busybox nc loop (cirros). dir=/var/www/clutter mkdir -p "$dir" page() { printf '%s

%s

%s

\n' "$1" "$1" "$2" > "$dir/index.html"; } page web "Served by its startup script on port 80." cd "$dir" if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup python3 -m http.server 80 >/var/log/clutter-web.log 2>&1 & elif busybox --list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx httpd; then busybox httpd -p 80 -h "$dir" else while true; do { printf 'HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n'; cat "$dir/index.html"; } | nc -l -p 80 >/dev/null 2>&1; done & fi
